inputs.name: joint/product under free recombination
inputs.cite: R4 G1 via Ga Check (quoted, not rerun)

day.reading: P(all) = p^n is the probability that all required fixations occur
day.holds: every printed power reproduces (Ga to 0.06% of the exponent; Gb and the Darwillion exactly)

critic.reading: p^n prices a pre-specified set of arisings and has no timing term
critic.holds: the product is order- and schedule-invariant (exact), so it cannot force sequential fixation

notes: The three figures are three (p, n) pairs, not one quantity: 0.02^(2e7), 0.5^157,000 and (5e-5)^(2e7). Each is a product of per-event probabilities and so is the same for any ordering or overlap of the events (asserted on rationals). Independence is a modelling premise; R4 G1's simulation gives joint/product 1.03 at free recombination and below 1 when linked (Day's direction), quoted here. Which event the history requires (a named list or any k of M) is M-704.
